g.text: Two views of one address space
the kernel keeps the list on the left; the hardware reads the table on the right; both describe the same addresses
not present (in a zone: not touched yet)
not present (in a zone: not touched yet)
not present (in a zone: not touched yet)
not present (in a zone: not touched yet)
The list says what the process may do with an address; the table says whether a frame is there right now.
The shell: 33 zones, about 2,600 pages, 1,100 of them present.
